name: react-sol-advisor
description: Luna-first React delivery for Codex with explicit Terra / High escalation and fresh Sol review.

interface.shortDescription: Route React work through Luna / Max, escalate to Terra / High, and verify before acceptance.
interface.longDescription: React Sol Advisor is a Luna-first React delivery orchestrator for Codex. GPT-5.6 Sol stays in the primary session for architecture, decomposition, verification, and acceptance. The default economy policy routes bounded React, Next.js, React Native, and Expo work through user-visible GPT-5.6 Luna / Max app tasks. The balanced and critical policies escalate to a separately installed GPT-5.6 Terra / High native role and require a fresh Sol review for red or high-blast-radius work. Optional Linear intake is read-only and never a hard dependency.
defaultPrompt: For economy React work, route to Luna / Max and keep review in the parent task.
For critical React work, keep architecture in Sol, route implementation through Terra / High, then require a fresh Sol review.
